contexts.text: Spirits who relate to the most sticky things of the brain. Explained. AC 5724.
Those who relate to the sticky things of the blood. References.
Sickness of mind from viscous and bilious blood.

Some (there) who are as it were sticky, who retain whatever has been done in opposition to them... They are such as here had long retained revenge; and are as it were sticky. (They are this sticky mucus of the nostrils. SE 1268.) SE 1270.
There are shockingly sticky Hells for those whose delights have been varieties...
They saw upon the earth a stickiness, and worms in the stickiness.
